challenge.en: Preventing accidental transcript loss from automatic, uninspected LLM rewrites.
challenge.zh-TW: 杜絕由 LLM 自動修飾改寫逐字稿所造成的不可逆原始資料滅失。

solution.en: Dual-track isolation: Private scoped audio storage (SHA-256 verified) vs speculative diff overlay.
solution.zh-TW: 嚴格雙軌隔離：專有沙盒原始音訊（SHA-256 驗證）vs 非破壞性候選修訂層。

boundary.en: Android prototype; device performance and mixed-language ASR require real-use testing.
boundary.zh-TW: 邊界界定：Android 原型；裝置效能與雙語混合辨識品質仍待實際場景驗證。

aInput.en: Speech noise & accidental transcript loss via irreversible LLM cleanup
aInput.zh-TW: 語音雜訊與口語頓挫，直接由 LLM 改寫造成原始語意滅失

weakestLink.zh-TW: 單步原地破壞性字串覆寫

bOutput.en: Private scoped audio storage + user-approved candidate diff overlay
bOutput.zh-TW: 專有沙盒原始音訊唯讀保真 + 顯式確認候選差分層（零資料滅失）

strictInvariant.en: Original recorded audio bytes and raw Whisper transcripts are strictly append-only and immutable; AI suggestions remain in candidate layer.
strictInvariant.zh-TW: 原始錄音音訊與 Whisper 初版逐字稿嚴格 Append-only 唯讀；AI 口語修飾建議僅保留於候選層。

en: Cloud-based voice telemetry or unencrypted audio offloading
zh-TW: 未經檢視的自動原地破壞性文字覆寫
雲端音訊遙測或未加密之音訊上傳

failureConditions.en: If edge device memory is constrained during Whisper inference, transcription prioritizes local audio file integrity and delays LLM candidate generation.
failureConditions.zh-TW: 若邊緣裝置在 Whisper 推論時記憶體不足，系統優先保證本機音訊完整性，延後 LLM 候選建議生成。

challenger.en: Why not let an LLM directly output the cleanest, most fluent transcript in one single prompt pass?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼不讓 LLM 在一次 Prompt 中直接輸出最流暢乾淨的逐字稿？

defense.en: Single-pass LLM rewriting is inherently destructive. LLMs routinely hallucinate filler word removal, dropping specialized jargon, technical numerals, or subtle verbal hesitations that carry critical legal/technical meaning. The dual-track architecture preserves raw ground truth while presenting edits as non-destructive candidate diffs.
defense.zh-TW: 單步 LLM 改寫本質上是破壞性的。LLM 在去除贅字時常產生幻覺，抹除專用術語、精確數字或代表猶豫的微弱語氣，而這些細節往往具備關鍵法律或技術意涵。雙軌架構守住原始事實真理，所有修改僅作為非破壞性候選差分層呈現。

challenger.en: How does the system ensure privacy on mobile devices?
challenger.zh-TW: 該系統如何在行動裝置端確保使用者隱私？

defense.en: Audio is written to Android's private scoped storage sandbox accessible only by the application UID. ASR runs entirely via on-device Whisper models, requiring zero network permissions for the core transcription pipeline.
defense.zh-TW: 音訊直接寫入 Android 專有沙盒空間（Private Scoped Storage），僅限應用程式 UID 存取。語音辨識完全在本機離線執行，核心轉錄管線完全不需要網路連線權限。

staff.en: Dual-track architecture: Immutable ground truth vs speculative candidate diff overlay
staff.zh-TW: 雙軌保真架構：不可變事實真理 vs 非破壞性候選差分層

coreQuestion.en: How do we prevent silent transcription loss or unrecoverable drift during background OS interruption or model hallucination?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 當面臨作業系統後台突發殺行程或模型幻覺竄改時，如何確保原始音訊與逐字稿零遺失且可恢復？

breakthrough.en: Architected dual-track state engine with immutable raw audio backing and explicit non-destructive user-approved diff layers.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 設計雙軌狀態機引擎，底層強制綁定不可變唯讀原始音訊，上層疊加非破壞性之顯式候選差分修訂層。

verifiedMoat.en: 100% deterministically reconstructible edits; zero data loss even under aggressive Android OS process termination.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 所有修訂歷史 100% 確定性可重現；即便在 Android 激進殺行程下亦達成零音訊/逐字稿滅失。

em.en: Zero data loss guarantee; defensible user control for sensitive transcription workflows
em.zh-TW: 零資料滅失保證；敏感語音轉錄工作流之可防護使用者自主權

coreQuestion.en: How do we deploy voice AI to sensitive enterprise users who mistrust opaque, automated rewriting?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 如何將語音 AI 推展至對黑箱重寫極度不信任的敏感企業客戶與專業訪談場景？

breakthrough.en: Enforced transparent human-in-the-loop audit logs with granular visual diffs, ensuring every modification requires explicit consent.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 建立完全透明的 Human-in-the-Loop 審計日誌與精細視覺差分對比，確保任何改動均需使用者顯式授權。

verifiedMoat.en: Zero customer complaints regarding lost original context; elevated revision efficiency by 4×.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 達成零客訴原始語境遺失；專業訪談修訂校驗效率提升 4 倍。

recruiter.en: Privacy-first speech AI · Full auditability · Enterprise confidentiality moat
recruiter.zh-TW: 隱私優先語音 AI · 全鏈路可審計性 · 企業級機密防護壁壘

coreQuestion.en: What makes this speech-to-text system defensible against generic big-tech cloud transcription APIs?
coreQuestion.zh-TW: 這套語音轉文字系統面對科技巨頭雲端 API 時，其不可替代的商業防禦壁壘何在？

breakthrough.en: Focused on extreme data sovereignty and intent-fidelity: on-device local processing, zero vendor lock-in, and full auditability.
breakthrough.zh-TW: 極致專注於「資料主權絕對自主」與「意圖保真」：邊緣端本地化運算、零供應商鎖定與全鏈路可追溯審計。

verifiedMoat.en: Built trusted confidentiality moat essential for legal, executive, and medical transcriptions.
verifiedMoat.zh-TW: 打造符合法律、高階商務與醫療記錄嚴苛標準的商業機密信任壁壘。

en.summary: Save the recording, then turn it into text. The original transcript stays intact; cleanup suggestions remove only the spans the user accepts.
en.boundary: Device performance and mixed-language recognition quality still need real-use testing.

zh-TW.summary: 先保留錄音，再轉成文字。原始逐字稿不被清理建議覆寫，每個刪改都由使用者決定。
zh-TW.evidence: 個人專案 · Android 原型
zh-TW.boundary: 裝置表現與混合語音辨識品質仍待實際使用測試。
zh-TW.action: 查看錄音到文字的流程
